description: KISA infra+web vulnerability scan on Linux; uploads CSV to S3 results/. Reuses kisa_all_check.ps1 from S3 tools/ (fetched via instance role).

S3Base.description: S3 base prefix (tools/ and results/ live under it).

runCommand: if ! command -v aws >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '[*] installing aws cli...'; curl -sSL https://awscli.amazonaws.com/awscli-exe-linux-x86_64.zip -o /tmp/awscliv2.zip && (cd /tmp && rm -rf aws && unzip -q awscliv2.zip && ./aws/install -u -b /usr/local/bin) || true; fi
command -v aws >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo '[!] aws CLI not available; install it on this host and retry.'; exit 1; }
ls scan/*.csv >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo '[!] no CSV produced'; exit 1; }
